start.title: Import games from BoardGameGeek
start.description: Import your game collection from BoardGameGeek. You can select which games you want to import in the next step.

import.intro: We found {{count}} games in your BGG collection, {{collectionCount}} are already included in your local collection. Select what games you want to import. Select max {{maxImport}} games at any time, this is to prevent stress on the bgg website.
import.hide-collected: Hide games that are in your collection already
import.error-rate-limited: BoardGameGeek is rate-limiting your API key. Wait a minute and try again.
import.error-preparing: BoardGameGeek is still preparing this collection. Give it a moment and try again.
import.error-timeout: BoardGameGeek took too long to answer. Try again in a moment.
import.error-unauthorized: BoardGameGeek rejected the request. Check the API key in the settings.
import.error-unknown: Something went wrong while fetching your collection from BoardGameGeek. Please try again.
import.failed-rate-limited: BoardGameGeek is rate-limiting your API key. Wait a minute and import again.
import.failed-preparing: BoardGameGeek is still preparing the data. Try the import again in a moment.
import.failed-timeout: The import took too long. Select fewer games or try again in a moment.
import.failed-unauthorized: BoardGameGeek rejected the request. Check the API key in the settings.
import.failed-unknown: Failed importing games from BoardGameGeek, check logs for more details.
